question: Should OpenClaw accept the narrowed hot-mode contract where security-critical auth/profile/provider-secret edits auto-restart but routine config.patch/config.apply writes only return a requiresRestart notice?
rationale: This changes gateway/auth/provider-sensitive runtime behavior for existing hot-mode setups, so the security-versus-availability and RPC-compatibility tradeoff needs maintainer intent rather than an automated merge verdict.

options.title: Accept Current Narrowed Contract
options.body: Land this PR after maintainer sign-off, treating routine hot mode as warn-and-keep and security-critical auth/profile/provider-secret edits as restart-required.

options.title: Keep Old RPC Restart Semantics
options.body: Ask the author to preserve direct restart for routine hot-mode config.patch/config.apply writes while keeping the file-watcher security carve-out.

options.title: Pause For Diagnostics Only
options.body: Defer behavior changes and rely on the companion drift/health diagnostics work while maintainers settle the permanent hot-mode policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Narrowed Contract
recommendation.body: Land this PR after maintainer sign-off, treating routine hot mode as warn-and-keep and security-critical auth/profile/provider-secret edits as restart-required.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent and historical ownership signal for gateway reload, SecretRef rotation, and planner policy decisions.
